answers.question: 2026 年 9 月已支付订单总额是多少
answers.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM orders WHERE status='已支付' AND created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

answers.question: 2026 年 9 月已支付订单数是多少
answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已支付' AND created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

answers.question: 2026 年 9 月订单对应退款金额是多少
answers.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE o.status='已支付' AND o.created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

answers.question: 2026 年 9 月净销售额是多少
answers.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_cents),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_cents) FROM refunds r JOIN orders ro ON ro.id=r.order_id WHERE ro.status='已支付' AND ro.created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND ro.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'),0) FROM orders o WHERE o.status='已支付' AND o.created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

answers.question: 2026 年 9 月退款前客单价是多少
answers.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) FROM orders WHERE status='已支付' AND created_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

answers.question: 全年复购用户数是多少
